name: Pi de Can Reiet

location.address: Roadside at km 1.6 of the road from Santa Eularia des Riu to Sant Joan de Labritja

access: Free, visible from a public road. Owned by the Consell Insular d'Eivissa i Formentera (the island council itself), catalogued 1993.
transport: By car, roughly 20 minutes from Ibiza Town along the road to Sant Joan; the tree stands at the km 1.6 marker. No specific bus stop identified; nearest regular service runs into Santa Eularia des Riu, about 1.6 km away by road.
verify_notes: Register (CAIB Servei de Proteccio d'Especies, official fitxa) gives trunk diameter 111 cm at the base; converted to a circumference/girth of approx 349 cm using pi (source states diameter, not circumference, flagging this so the writer does not repeat 111 as girth). Age 100-150 years given directly by the register and repeated in periodicodeibiza.es (2022) survey of Ibiza's singular trees, which independently corroborates species, age band and location description ('a large specimen notable for its 111cm diameter trunk'). Register notes the tree is unbalanced, with an inclined crown, requiring regular branch maintenance; a metal hunting-ban plate was once fixed to and later removed from the trunk. Ownership is public (Consell Insular), roadside location on a public road confirmed by both sources as visible and accessible, no indication of restricted access. Catalogued as a singular tree 11 June 1993. Two independent sources for species, age and location: the official register plus a periodicodeibiza.es news survey.
